description: This file manages Lark application access tokens, including fetching, refreshing, and handling app tickets with API interactions, token expiration checks, and database updates.

methods.name: makePoolingPromise
methods.description: Retries a promise creator function multiple times with delay until success or attempts exhausted.

methods.name: getValidAppKeys
methods.description: Retrieves and validates application keys from storage.

methods.name: getAppTicketFromKeys
methods.description: Extracts the app ticket from validated app keys.

methods.name: getAppTicket
methods.description: Obtains the app ticket, triggering a resend if necessary, with polling for update.

methods.name: getAppAccessToken
methods.description: Fetches a valid app access token, refreshing it if expired or invalid, and updates the database.
